theorem erdos_1094__h3__h3__h1__h1__h1__h1__h2__h1__h4 : ∀ (G : ℂ → ℂ) (g : ℝ → ℝ),
  Filter.Tendsto
    (fun (X : ℝ) =>
      ∫ (ξ : ℝ),
        FourierTransform.fourier (fun (u : ℝ) => (↑(g u) : ℂ)) ξ *
            Complex.exp (-((2 : ℂ) * (↑Real.pi : ℂ) * Complex.I * (↑(Real.log X) : ℂ) * (↑ξ : ℂ))) *
          G ((1 : ℂ) - (2 : ℂ) * (↑Real.pi : ℂ) * Complex.I * (↑ξ : ℂ)))
    Filter.atTop (nhds (0 : ℂ)) := by
  sorry
